strict_consistency.description: All nodes seeing identical data instantly, global clock at top

sequential_consistency.description: Operations from two clients interleaved in a valid global sequence

causal_consistency.description: Causally related operations ordered, unrelated operations free to reorder

eventual_consistency.description: Replicas diverge temporarily then converge to same value over time

eventual_anomalies.description: User updates profile picture but sees old picture on refresh

read_your_writes.description: User always sees their own writes; other users may see stale data

monotonic_reads.description: Successive reads never return older values, shown on ascending timeline

implementation_strategies.description: Strategies for implementing read-your-writes: sticky sessions and version numbers

full_spectrum.description: Full consistency spectrum from strict to eventual with performance/availability trade-offs
